title: With foundation-model features, aggregator complexity does not improve cross-hospital discrimination in gastric whole-slide image classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.41328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whole-slide image classifiers are usually developed within one hospital and often go untested at unseen hospitals. We assembled 5,036 haematoxylin-and-eosin-stained gastric slides from five Korean hospitals, scanned at 20x and 40x, and compared multiple-instance learning aggregators under leave-one-hospital-out validation on frozen pathology foundation-model features. A hierarchical patch-region-slide graph aggregator (CHIME-MIL) with site alignment and two-scale fusion reached a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.837, above six conventional attention and transformer aggregators trained without these steps. Under a matched recipe it did not exceed attention-based pooling, and global max pooling given the same alignment and fusion was better (AUC 0.855, P = 0.0002). translated_title: 基于病理基础模型特征时，聚合器复杂度并不能提升胃部全切片图像分类的跨医院判别能力
translated_abstract: 全切片图像分类器通常在单一医院内开发，且往往未在未见过的医院进行测试。我们收集了来自韩国五家医院的5,036张苏木精-伊红染色的胃部切片（扫描倍率为20倍和40倍），在冻结的病理基础模型特征上，采用留一医院验证方法比较了多种多示例学习聚合器。一个带有站点对齐和双尺度融合的分层“图像块-区域-切片”图聚合器（CHIME-MIL）达到了平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）0.837，高于六个未使用这些步骤训练的常规注意力与Transformer聚合器。然而在匹配的实验设置下，它并未超越基于注意力的池化方法，而采用相同对齐与融合策略的全局最大池化表现更佳（AUC 0.855，P = 0.0002）。该对齐方法无需标签即可减去每家医院的平均特征向量，仅需十张未标注切片即可完成一家新医院的接入。
tldr: 在冻结的病理基础模型特征上，配合站点对齐与双尺度融合的简单池化聚合器即可达到与复杂图聚合器相当甚至更好的跨医院胃部全切片分类性能，表明聚合器的复杂度并非提升跨医院判别能力的关键。
en_tdlr: On frozen pathology foundation-model features, aggregator complexity does not improve cross-hospital discrimination in gastric whole-slide image classification, as simple pooling with site alignment and two-scale fusion matches or outperforms complex graph-based aggregators.
